turns.text: Hello, I just opened my delivery and the print has a deep crease along the corner.

I'm sorry your print arrived creased. I can file a damage claim for you. First, please send your order number (it starts with SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with. Once I've verified the order, I'll ask a few details about the damage.
Order SC-4090, email is emily.clark.v2@example.com. Please file a damage claim for a refund.

Thank you, Emily. I've filed damage claim R-1 for order SC-4090 (Whispering Pines, 40x50 cm) with a refund requested. It is pending staff approval. Staff will ask you for a photo of the crease and make the decision, so please keep the print and its packaging. I can't confirm the refund amount or timing until staff have reviewed the claim.

change.description: Print arrived with a deep crease along the corner.

turns.text: Actually, I really love the art itself. Could I please get a reprint instead of a refund?

Done. I've changed damage claim R-1 for order SC-4090 from a refund to a reprint. It is still pending staff approval. Staff will ask you for a photo of the crease and make the final decision. I can't confirm when a reprint would be made or sent until staff have reviewed it.
